mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an accommodative monetary policy stance, reducing the discount rate for equity valuations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 0.5%, it signals a tightening monetary policy that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 0.5%, or the Rank IC remains above 0.03 for less than 30% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in the federal funds rate and a decline in the core inflation rate (CPIAUCSL) signals a 'soft landing' monetary policy, where the central bank is successfully cooling inflation without triggering a recession, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS rises and CPIAUCSL falls, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 24-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a high labor market tightness regime (UNRATE < 3.5%), a decline in the unemployment rate signals strong labor demand, boosting consumer spending and corporate earnings, which drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE < 3.5%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1700.0 thousand units, it signals a contraction in the housing sector, reducing consumer wealth and spending, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST < 1700.0, or the Rank IC remains above 0.03 for less than 30% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signals a broad-based contraction in consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where HOUST and RSAFS both decline, or the Rank IC is above 0.03 over less than 30% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: In an early-cycle expansion regime (INDPRO > 105.0), a rising industrial production index signals strengthening supply capacity, which supports corporate profitability and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO > 105.0, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 105.0, it signals a contraction in manufacturing output, reducing corporate earnings and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 105.0, or the Rank IC remains above 0.03 for less than 30% of the time.
